title: Call Me Bae season 2 premieres worldwide on Prime Video on 17 December
headline: Call Me Bae Season 2 Hits Prime Video 17 December
caption:
Call Me Bae season 2 premieres on Prime Video on 17 December, Prime Video has announced.

Ananya Panday returns as Bella “Bae” Chowdhary in the eight-episode Hindi series. Shruti Kamal Haasan joins the cast, and Vir Das, Gurfateh Pirzada, Varun Sood, Vihaan Samat, Muskkaan Jaferi, Niharika Lyra Dutt, Lisa Mishra and Mini Mathur are back.

Ishita Moitra created the show and Collin D’Cunha directs it for Dharmatic Entertainment, with Karan Johar, Adar Poonawalla and Apoorva Mehta producing.
